push.title: L 1-2 vs Dagestan SC | You: 9.3 (2nd best match performance)
push.body:
buddskees, your 2nd best match performance at 9.3. Good as gold.

DID WELL
+ 31 passes, your busiest match yet. You were the hub of the wheel.
+ Won 3 of 4 tackles. Clean win, no foul, ball's ours. Beautiful.
+ A goal against Dagestan SC. That's a finish they'll replay at the club banquet.
+ Man of the Match, your 3rd for us. Everybody wants to play with someone who plays like that.
+ 1.3 above usual. That's not luck, that's reps.

WORK ON
- Pass accuracy: 77%. Good foundation, 87%+ ceiling.
- Tackles attempted: 4. 6+ is the gold standard for a midfielder.
- Key passes: 1. A little more and you're in the 2+ crowd.
- Lost 1-2. It stings, and stings fade.

Between you and me, buddskees: Doubt is a guest. Don't give it the spare room.

What a joy. What a game. - Coach Lasso

players.name: BellyTb1

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 0 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

weaknesses.detail: 13/24 passes (54%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

weaknesses.detail: 0 goals from 2 shots on target - the keeper is getting to them
weaknesses.title: Finishing
tips: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.
Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard.
Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.
weaknesses.coach: You're hitting the target, so now let's beat the keeper.

push.title: L 1-2 vs Dagestan SC | You: 6.5 (6th worst match performance)
push.body:
Your 6th worst match performance, BellyTb1, at 6.5. Chin up, cleats on.

DID WELL
+ You gave us 92 minutes. That's a full tank, and I noticed.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted. From the clipboard: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts. Next match, nail it.
- 54% passing (13 of 24, down from your usual 75%). Simple as pie: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
- 0 goals from 2 on target. Focus point: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.
- Heads up, you and PhogsToffees: forcing passes. Simple fix: give each other short options.
- 1.2 below your norm. We'll get you back to you.

Muscle memory: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

One thought for the road, BellyTb1: Stay humble, hustle hard, hydrate harder.

The comeback starts now. - Coach Lasso

tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
weaknesses.coach: A few too many shots went wide or over. Better looks, better results.

push.title: L 1-2 vs Dagestan SC | You: 6.4 (4th worst match performance)
push.body:
A 6.4 from PhogsToffees. Tough day at the office. Leave it at the office.

DID WELL
+ You and buddskees were finishing each other's sentences out there.
+ 1 key pass: +0.2. Little things, big difference.

WORK ON

- 1.4 under your usual. Bad days are tuition for good ones.
- That 6.4 is your 4th worst match performance. One game, one lesson.

Practice prescription: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

Last thing, PhogsToffees. Practice like you're second, play like you're first.

Rome wasn't built in a day, but they were laying bricks every hour. - Coach Lasso
